PATTERN: Break room = idle (Stop hook fires). Planning room = worker is actively planning (SubagentStop? or detected from transcript — long thinking, no tool calls, writing a plan).
COMPONENTS: New room in canvas separate from break room. Worker routes there when state transitions to 'planning'. Workers return to desk when first tool call fires.
WHY: Ned wants spatial meaning — break room = waiting, planning room = thinking/strategizing. Makes the office readable at a glance.
REJECTED: Just using break room for both idle and planning — loses spatial meaning.
IMPLEMENTATION STATUS: Concept only, not yet designed or built.
